lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 850 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: When they were tryin' to get me off the ground an, cuz there was my mom, Blaine, Bryan, Bobbie and Steven, tryin' to get me into the Suburban. But when they couldn't do that because it was really hard for 'em to get me up.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So are you strong?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You pretty strong?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No, I just like to squirm a lot.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: (laugh) OK.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then when they couldn't do that, Steven he dropped me and then he started punching me and that.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Where was he punching you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like in the face and the arms.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he lose his temper, is that what happened?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was he swearing at you and stuff?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: No, was your mom there when Steven was hitting you in the face?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did she do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She told 'em to stop.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Did he cause you to bleed at all?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No he just gave me a few bruises.
